hit_assessment.from: Semantic Scholar q3, run 1, HTTP 200, total=1
hit_assessment.title: Exact self-similar finite-time blowup of the Hou-Luo model with smooth profiles
hit_assessment.abstract_verbatim: We show that the 1D Hou-Luo model on the real line admits exact self-similar finite-time blowup solutions with smooth self-similar profiles. The existence of these profiles is established via a fixed-point method that is purely analytic. We also prove that the profiles satisfy some monotonicity and convexity properties that were unknown before, and we give rigorous estimates on the algebraic decay rates of the profiles in the far field. Our result supplements the previous computer-assisted proof of self-similar finite-time blowup for the Hou-Luo model with finer characterizations of the profiles.
hit_assessment.predates_note: 2023-08-03 vs leg 382's landing in 2026-08; it predates plainly
hit_assessment.duplication_assessment: NOT a duplicate, on two independent grounds, both read off the abstract. (1) OBJECT: the 1D Hou-Luo model on the real line, not a 3D NS DSS radial profile. (2) METHOD: the abstract states the existence is established 'via a fixed-point method' that is 'purely analytic', and the far-field decay result is a set of hand-proved 'rigorous estimates on the algebraic decay rates'. Leg 382's instrument is the opposite construction: it CONSUMES a given, computed profile and eliminates an unknown amplitude from a log-log tube by Fourier-Motzkin over interval arithmetic. An analytic theorem about a profile one has constructed by hand does not duplicate an interval-arithmetic measurement instrument that reads an exponent off supplied data.
hit_assessment.relevance_flag: HIGH -- routed to integration, NOT actioned by this leg
hit_assessment.why_flagged: the abstract contains the phrase 'rigorous estimates on the algebraic decay rates of the profiles in the far field'. That is materially adjacent to CLAY_OBLIGATIONS.md §6 item 1, and it shows there is an ANALYTIC route to rigorous far-field algebraic decay for a blowup profile in a related model. Integration may want this in view; it does not change any leg-382 measurement.
hit_assessment.confidence_caveat: the full text was NOT read -- the wind-down landed before a PDF fetch. A successor must read 2308.01528 §far-field before treating this assessment as settled. Stated as a limit, not smoothed over.
hit_assessment.action_routed_to_integration: NONE REQUIRED for leg 382's novelty record on this hit, because the hit does not duplicate. This leg edits no landed novelty file, as its territory forbids.
